In around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a '''starship repair facility''' was run by the Empire on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] [[Mission to Rori|attacked]] it, but were repelled by a unit of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] who were repairing their starship there at the time.
